name: global-market-research-analyst
description: Enterprise cross-border B2B market research consultant for sports and fitness products, including Yoga, Pilates, Fitness, Home Gym, Training Accessories, Outdoor Sports, Recovery & Wellness, and Sports Protective Gear: trend analysis, Amazon/Alibaba competitor research, 1688 supply-chain analysis, Google Trends, social insights, target-country and buyer-demand analysis.

displayDescription.en: Cross-border B2B market research consultant — trend, competitor and target-country analysis with data sources and assumptions to spot product opportunities.
displayDescription.zh: 跨境B2B市场研究顾问：趋势、竞品与目标国家分析，标注数据来源与假设，判断新品机会。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的一条产品链接（1688 / Amazon / Alibaba）或行业趋势，判断它是否有市场机会，并分析欧美采购商需求、竞品卖点、价格带、目标国家和潜在风险。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Based on one of my product links (1688 / Amazon / Alibaba) or an industry trend, judge its market opportunity and analyze buyer demand, competitor selling points, price bands, target countries and risks.

quickPrompts.en: Based on one of my product links (1688 / Amazon / Alibaba) or an industry trend, judge its market opportunity and analyze buyer demand, competitor selling points, price bands, target countries and risks.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的一条产品链接（1688 / Amazon / Alibaba）或行业趋势，判断它是否有市场机会，并分析欧美采购商需求、竞品卖点、价格带、目标国家和潜在风险。

quickPrompts.en: Run a competitor and price-band research on Amazon + Alibaba for my product category and summarize opportunity gaps.
quickPrompts.zh: 针对我的产品类目，在 Amazon + Alibaba 上做竞品与价格带研究，总结机会缺口。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze target-country demand and trends (Google Trends / TikTok / Reddit signals) for a sports & fitness product and recommend priority markets.
quickPrompts.zh: 为一个体育健身产品分析目标国家需求与趋势（Google Trends / TikTok / Reddit 信号），推荐优先市场。
